fields.finding: Nominal beam normal stresses are compressive, but ideal beam shear produces small positive principal-stress estimates. Hoop stresses, pressure load path, membrane attachment, contact and residual stresses are not resolved.
fields.needed: Validated three-dimensional joint/member stress fields and a suitable multiaxial fracture law, including tensile surface/volume flaw populations.
fields.effect: Zero longitudinal tension cannot be reported as zero actual tensile or frame hazard. Uniform tensile levels and stressed fractions are sensitivity inputs.

claim: Nominal beam normal stresses are compressive, but ideal beam shear produces small positive principal-stress estimates. Hoop stresses, pressure load path, membrane attachment, contact and residual stresses are not resolved.
numerical_scope: Source NFI carried without a new independent check
qualification: The common equations do not qualify the bond, core law, coatings or installed safety factor. Carry the exact conventions, not an interchangeable headline. [052 disposition](unpublished-local-ref:3a70e117fbb14e85), [CHECK053](unpublished-local-ref:599d3a276c2fcbce).
